profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I'm a lead software engineer with 11 years building distributed systems and developer platforms within regulated environments.

 I've led the architecture and technical direction for a platform that orchestrates all communications with partners and processes millions of events on AWS microservices.

I've led a zero-loss migration of that platform across AWS accounts under tight SLAs — three tightly coupled Spring Boot streams consuming and producing across Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQS, and Kafka, with no dropped or duplicated requests — along with platform-wide migrations from HashiCorp Vault to AWS Secrets Manager and to Spring Boot 4. Additionally, I've shipped a document-intelligence pipeline that replaces manual report review and is projected to save analyst teams significant report-analysis time each month.

I can support PCI, NPI, and model-risk reviews: classifying sensitive data, confirming violations, and remediating through tokenization and masking. On one LLM initiative, data classification surfaced highly confidential information, and I re-architected the solution and decomposed the work for my team before we built it.

I also ran the JFrog Artifactory platform ecosystem used by every technology organization in the company. Automation I delivered removed a manual step from every team's release process.

My focus: platforms other engineers build on, APIs that stay reliable at scale, and standards that outlive any single project. As an organization's designated Testing Champion, I ran office hours helping 4+ engineering teams strengthen their testing posture and report progress to leadership.

I mentor engineers, interview for coding and system design as part of our consensus hiring process, and lead cross-functional delivery from technical scoping through production — work recognized twice with Technical Engineering Excellence awards.

positions.description: Architecting, developing, and managing services for external customers seeking optimal auto loan deals through Capital One.

positions.title: Principal Associate Software Engineer (Artifactory)
positions.description: Leveraging a myriad of integrated technologies, micro services, and AWS infrastructure, the Artifactory team provides an ecosystem surrounding JFrog’s binary repository manager for Capital One. positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Compute Tribe - Bare Metal Team

Developed SoftLayer API with Compute Tribe, focusing on Bare Metal provisions for worldwide customers.
Implemented and improved automated system services for failure notifications, server recovery, and feature deployment testing.

Data center launch lead for OS image, VSI, and Bare Metal server provisions.
Further developed employee portal to manage, update, and display inventory, spanning component level objects to servers by data center.
Contributed to class architecture and implementation of new products for fortune 500 companies.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Compute Tribe - Bare Metal Team

The Bare Metal team develops the features that will define the future of cloud technology in the hosting industry. We build and maintain the most innovative systems in our field using team coordination tools, networking technologies, and data center knowledge to deliver creative solutions for product stakeholders on a global scale.
